description.value: Nemesis is a specialty coffee roaster and multi-location cafe headquartered in Vancouver, with the Gastown flagship at 302 West Hastings Street offering espresso, filter coffee, and pastries from their in-house Dope Bakehouse. The company sources single-origin coffees directly from named producers and proudly supports World Coffee Research. Touring cyclists will find both indoor and outdoor seating at this well-established stop in the heart of Gastown.
